units.source_text: 月亮出来了，天色清丽可爱。

en.t: The moon had risen, and the sky was clear and lovely.

units.source_text: 正在此时，昼间寄信来的中将到草庵来访问了。

en.t: Just then, the Lieutenant General who had sent a letter during the day came to visit the thatched hermitage.

units.source_text: 浮舟想道：“啊呀，不好了，怎么办呢？”

en.t: Ukifune thought, "Oh no, this is bad. What am I to do?"

units.source_text: 立刻躲进最深的内室里去。

en.t: She immediately hid herself in the innermost room.

units.source_text: 少将对她说道：“这未免太不近人情了。

en.t: Shosho said to her, "This is really too unfeeling.

units.source_text: 月白风清之夜特地造访，此心也应体谅。

en.t: On a moonlit night with such a clear wind, he has come all this way; you ought to understand his feelings.

units.source_text: 还请小姐约略听听他说的话吧。

en.t: Please, my lady, at least listen briefly to what he has to say.

units.source_text: 不要以为听听男人讲话就会玷污身体的。”

en.t: Do not think that merely hearing a man speak will defile your body."

units.source_text: 浮舟听了这话，深恐她带那男人进来，很是担心。

en.t: Hearing this, Ukifune grew very worried, fearing that Shosho might bring the man inside.

units.source_text: 她想推说出门去了，然而昼间那个使者曾经问明浮舟一人留在家中，早已回去报告了。

en.t: She wanted to claim that she had gone out, but the messenger from earlier had already confirmed that Ukifune was at home alone and had gone back to report it.

units.source_text: 因此中将说了许多怨恨的话。

en.t: Because of this, the Lieutenant General spoke many resentful words.

units.source_text: 他说：“我并不想听见小姐亲口说话的声音，

en.t: He said, "I do not ask to hear the lady's own voice,

units.source_text: 只希望她稍稍接近我些，听听我的诉说，

en.t: I only hope she will come a little closer to me and listen to my plea,
and tell me whether what I say is right or wrong."

units.source_text: 他说得舌疲唇焦，始终不得答复，便口出恨言道：

en.t: He talked until his tongue and lips were weary, but still received no answer, and at last spoke bitterly:

units.source_text: “气死我也！住在这风雅的山乡，应该更加懂得情趣。

en.t: "How infuriating! Living in this refined mountain village, she ought to understand feeling all the more.

units.source_text: 如此绝不理睬，太冷酷了！”

en.t: To ignore me so completely is far too cold-hearted!"
He immediately composed a poem and said:
